item.title: Socio‐economic position and the prevalence of ten chronic diseases in Australia, 2021: a whole of population census data analysis
item.description: admin Wed, 15/10/2025 - 10:21 The known: Socio‐economic position is a major risk factor for chronic disease. item.title: Changes in patient management after preoperative MRI for newly diagnosed breast cancer: a multicentre prospective observational study
item.description: admin Thu, 06/11/2025 - 11:06 The known: Preoperative breast MRI has higher sensitivity than conventional imaging, but little evidence confirms which patient subgroups are likely to benefit.
